title: A Loyal Friend
text: Lucky was a small brown dog. He lived with a kind old man. The old man gave him food and a warm bed. Lucky loved him very much. One day, the old man took Lucky to the park. He sat under a big tree and fell asleep. Some people walked by, but Lucky did not move. He sat next to the old man and watched. When a stranger came near, Lucky stood up and barked loudly. The old man woke up and smiled. He patted Lucky. "You are a good and loyal friend," he said. Dogs are our best friends. They love us and stay with us.
translation: Lucky 是一只棕色的小狗。他和一位善良的老人住在一起。老人给他食物和一张温暖的小床。Lucky 非常爱他。一天，老人带 Lucky 去公园。他坐在一棵大树下睡着了。一些人走过，但 Lucky 一动不动。他坐在老人旁边守着。当一个陌生人走近时，Lucky 站起来大声吠叫。老人醒来，笑了。他拍了拍 Lucky："你是一个忠诚的好朋友。"狗是我们最好的朋友，他们爱我们，陪伴我们。
